questions.q: How far ahead should I order?
questions.a: One week for cookies, cupcakes and loaves. Two weeks for custom cakes. Holiday weeks fill fast, so earlier is better. Last-minute? Send the form anyway and I'll do my best.
Pickup only for now, in Richmond Hill. You'll get the address once your order is confirmed.
Interac e-Transfer. Custom cakes need a 50% non-refundable deposit to book, with the balance due at pickup. Everything else is paid in full when booked.

Tell me about any allergies in your order. Gluten-free and egg-free options may be possible, but everything is made in a home kitchen that handles nuts, dairy, eggs, wheat and soy, so I can't guarantee anything is allergen-free.

questions.q: How big a cake do I need?
questions.a: A 6-inch cake serves about 8 to 12, and an 8-inch serves about 16 to 24. Tiered cakes are quoted on request.

questions.q: How should I transport my cake?
questions.a: Flat on the floor behind the passenger seat, with the A/C on in warm weather. Never on a seat. Keep it cool until it's time to serve.
